meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动在隔离环境中验证适配器改动并生成质检证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完适配器都要手动跑检查、怕漏掉问题
copy.tagline_en: Verify adapter changes in isolation and capture QA evidence automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change the adapter and need reliable isolated QA every time

howto.what: 它用真实的 senpi 二进制对 Senpi 适配器和 task 引擎做隔离实测，把每次运行的产物统一写到 .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/ 下，并留一份 README 说明测了什么、改动了哪些路径。
howto.when: 当你改动 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下的东西，或想对 Senpi 适配器、task/team 引擎、DAG、skill 投递做 QA、验证、调试时触发。

say.text: 先跑一遍 senpi 适配器驱动的 self-test
say.note: 执行驱动自检，检查隔离环境本身是否可用

say.text: 用真实 senpi 跑 task e2e，输出写到解析出的证据目录
say.note: 生成任务生命周期的实测证据文件

say.text: 验证 team 投递和重启恢复，并报告真实 agent 目录是否被动过
say.note: 检查投递、回收与 realSenpiUntouched 字段

howto.what_en: It runs live QA against the real senpi binary for the Senpi adapter and task engine in isolation, writing every artifact under .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/ plus a README of what was tested and which paths changed.
howto.when_en: Use when you change anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or want to QA, smoke-test, verify or debug the Senpi adapter, task/team engine, DAG or skill delivery.

say_en.text: Run the senpi adapter driver self-test first
say_en.note: Checks the driver and isolation harness itself

say_en.text: Run task e2e with the real senpi, output to the resolved evidence dir
say_en.note: Produces live task lifecycle evidence files

say_en.text: Verify team delivery and restart recovery, and report if the real agent dir was touched
say_en.note: Reports delivery, reclaim and realSenpiUntouched fields
